label: OpenCode: native create с точным instance и receipt
description: Независимая native часть V064A: реализовать create port над готовым OpenCode connection по существующему контракту NativeCreateControl. Не ждать application composition V023; не менять core interface.
acceptance: Изолированная native create операция возвращает точный SessionAddress данного instance; timeout/disconnect после возможной отправки даёт UNKNOWN без retry, preflight отказ без эффекта. Проверка источника ответа и отсутствие второй create через управляемый fixture. Общий application/MCP proof сохраняется в V064A/B/V064.
note: Выделено из V064A для параллельного выполнения после V029; существующий native seam, Cargo/lib/mod интегрирует Terra.

changes.result: Реализован native create port и fixture acceptance: scoped commit 0ea46b50, только crates/herder/src/adapters/opencode/create.rs и acceptance/native/opencode/session-create-response.json. Embedded mock tests: 4/4 passed, включая exact response ID/instance, preflight без POST, timeout UNKNOWN с ровно одним POST. Временный lib export восстановлен. Live native API и MCP proof не входят в этот результат; выделены отдельно.

progress_events.note: Create-local validation classification awaits shared-core integration by owner. After the two listed shared changes, classify invalid request key/specification/parentID as DefinitelyNotSent and preserve Unknown after any possible POST. No shared files changed.

blocker_details.target_rs: NativeCreateOutcome currently has only Confirmed and Unknown; add DefinitelyNotSent { reason: String }.
blocker_details.lib_rs: Export pub mod create in adapters::opencode.

progress_events.note: Earlier blocked annotation was based on stale parent 2413cbca. Verified integrated candidate d7b560d3 contains the core variant and create module export; no shared files changed.

changes.result: OpenCode native create validation fixed on integrated candidate d7b560d3 as commit 395eb202 (create.rs only). Invalid request key, invalid JSON/specification (including caller-selected id), and invalid parentID return NativeCreateOutcome::DefinitelyNotSent before POST. Request construction failures and proven connect failures map to DefinitelyNotSent; timeout/interrupted response, any non-success HTTP response, malformed response or post-response body failure remain Unknown without retry. Fixture confirms invalid inputs produce zero POST and timeout after POST is Unknown with one POST. In the 8-test OpenCode module suite, create/control passed 8/8.
